liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Intrasport**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Swan Song**: rare: 14 archived performances [5]
- **Black Tooth**: rare: 14 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-11-09.dpa4018.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 143 min [1]
- **kglw2024-11-09.THOR**: source not stated; 3 songs; 141 min [3]
- **kglw2024-11-09.bandcampbootlegger**: soundboard; 0 songs; 142 min [4]
- **kglw2024-11-09**: source not stated; 18 songs; 149 min [2]

## Around the show

- Cavs performed a drum solo during Gaia [2]
- Audience member Rob sang the intro to Nuclear Fusion [2]
- Ambrose and Stu shouted out Lucas for playing guitar on Intrasport [2]
- Microphones positioned approximately one hundred feet from stage, left of front of house [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-11-09.dpa4018.flac24**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4018c(DIN/DFC/front row of 203)->Sonosax M2D2(aes)->SD744T(24bit/96kHz) [1]. Also: Final three minutes patched from Discocape's Mk21 source recorded at the same stand [1]
- **kglw2024-11-09.THOR**: taped by puffanug; transferred by puffanug; source: ADK Thor>PMD 661> 24/96 wav [3]. Also: Sam Joseph recorded with ADK T7 THORs into a Marantz PMD661 [3]
- **kglw2024-11-09.bandcampbootlegger**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; source: SBD [4]
- **kglw2024-11-09**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: Schoeps cmc1k/mk21 [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Reverholic: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Poster For Show In Phoenix Arizona At Arizona Financial Theatre On November 9 2024 Ho](https://reverholic.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-poster-for-show-in-phoenix-arizona-at-arizona-financial-theatre-on-november-9-2024-home-decor-poster-canvas/) [6]
- Poster by Teeextra: [Official King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Nov 9 2024 Arizona Financial Theatre In Phoenix AZ Tour Shirt, hoodie, sweat](https://teeextra.com/product/official-king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-nov-9-2024-arizona-financial-theatre-in-phoenix-az-tour-shirt/) [7]
- Poster by Teeextra: [Official King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Nov 9 2024 Arizona Financial Theatre In Phoenix AZ Tour Shirt, hoodie, sweat](https://teeextra.com/product/official-king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-nov-9-2024-arizona-financial-theatre-in-phoenix-az-tour-shirt/) [8]
